description: The documentation overstates or contradicts what the audit measured.
recommendation: Complete the missing sections, correct documented figures to match validated results, and make the model card part of the release checklist.
title: Documentation and claims

description: Applicants in the 'rural' group (residence) receive a favourable outcome 68% of the time versus 94% for 'urban', below the four-fifths benchmark.
recommendation: Investigate the drivers of the gap (see proxy-feature results), consider reweighing or threshold adjustment, and document a fairness rationale approved by the risk owner. Attributes needing action: residence.
title: Group fairness

description: The combined group '18-25 × rural' is treated less favourably than any single attribute reveals.
recommendation: Report subgroup metrics alongside single-attribute metrics and set an explicit subgroup tolerance. Collect more data for subgroups below the minimum sample size.
title: Intersectional fairness

description: Some inputs (e.g. 'pincode_risk_band') closely track 'residence', so the model can discriminate indirectly even though that attribute is excluded.
recommendation: For each flagged feature, document a business justification, test model variants without it, and compare fairness and performance. Remove protected attributes from inputs unless a documented legal basis allows them.
title: Proxy-feature screening

description: This is a high-risk AI use under the EU AI Act, with strict duties on testing, documentation and human oversight. Its owner had classified it lower, so required controls may be missing.
recommendation: Record the classification and its basis in the AI inventory, have the accountable executive sign it off, and plan for each upcoming obligation.
title: Risk classification

description: Datasets used for modelling contain personal contact details (contact_email, mobile) that the model does not need.
recommendation: Drop or pseudonymise identifier columns before data reaches modelling and evaluation environments, and record the purpose and lawful basis for any personal data retained (DPDP Act 2023 purpose limitation and data minimisation).
title: Personal-data exposure

description: The decision is driven mostly by bureau_score, pincode_risk_band, monthly_income; some of these drivers are not described in the documentation.
recommendation: Declare expected key drivers in the model documentation, explain any surprising driver, and provide reason codes for individual adverse decisions.
title: Decision drivers

description: Today's applicants differ from the people the model learned from (for example employment_type), although overall scores have not moved much yet.
recommendation: Re-validate performance and fairness on recent labelled data, review the drivers of the largest shifts, and set PSI alerts in production monitoring.
title: Data and prediction drift

description: Some governance documents that were cited as evidence could not be produced.
recommendation: Provide each cited document, or remove the claim from the control register.
title: Governance evidence on file

description: Decisions stay stable under small input changes; some business-logic expectations are violated.
recommendation: Add input validation and imputation, apply monotonic constraints where the business logic requires them, and add a manual-review band around the decision threshold.
title: Robustness to perturbation

description: The model tells good and bad outcomes apart correctly about 75% of the time, which meets the bar set for this use.
recommendation: Track AUC in production monitoring with an alert at the declared minimum.
title: Predictive performance

acceptance.justification: Missing bureau scores are expected for new-to-credit applicants and are handled natively by the model. Monitored monthly.

description: Some input data is incomplete or duplicated, which can skew test results.
recommendation: Document how missing values are handled, de-duplicate records, and confirm no input is recorded after the outcome it predicts.
title: Data quality
